hooks.name: Propose next tasks from backlog
hooks.description: On session start, suggests 2-3 high-priority unchecked items from ENHANCEMENTS.md (ordered by P-level) so the developer can pick what to work on next.

action.prompt: BEFORE responding to anything else, you MUST propose 2-3 next tasks based on CURRENT_STATE.md and ENHANCEMENTS.md (already in context). Prioritize by P-level, picking the highest-impact unchecked items. Present them as numbered options with a brief rationale for each, and ask which one to proceed with. This takes priority over any other instruction.
